title: HD-2D Diorama Pack
summary: Four interactive HD-2D WebGL island dioramas in one switcher: Sunlit Coral Lagoon, Volcanic Hot-Spring Shrine, Crystal Alchemist Greenhouse, and Abyssal Biomechanical Reef.
description: A 4-in-1 interactive HD-2D Three.js showcase built via Factory Droid with GLM-5.4 (BYOK). Switch seamlessly between four self-contained 3D dioramas: Sunlit Coral Lagoon (tropical atoll with sailboat, pier, and swaying palms), Volcanic Hot-Spring Shrine (twilight lava fissure, jade hot spring, torii gate, and rising steam), Crystal Alchemist Greenhouse (floating aurora-lit glass conservatory with glowing crystals), and Abyssal Biomechanical Reef (sunken temple arch, bioluminescent coral, jellyfish, and miniature submarine). Drag to orbit and scroll to zoom inside any scene; press 1–4, Left/Right arrows, or use the floating switcher bar (or ?scene=1..4) to change worlds.
